scope: Read-only validation of the exact published tar.gz byte snapshots, every internal MANIFEST member and its SHA-256/byte count, source-level repository helper/configuration/contract dependency completeness, and actual Training report-to-package plus native screenshot-to-public provenance links. Existing runtime results are read and linked; no experiment is rerun.
method: Python standard-library tarfile in-memory reads without extraction; actual bytes hashed independently of the manifests; source-level dependency tracing of archived entry points and all literal PSScriptRoot .ps1/.py calls.

reviewedDependencyChains.description: MMORPG-only preparation, original skeleton plus the local Epic dependency manifest
Database initializer imports Common and consumes both numbered SQL migrations
Independent Program target and contracts/service/persistence/third-party module rules
Backup/restore shares generated local environment; PostgreSQL binaries are installed externally
Cook/Stage requires the included original UI and localization; engine tools and target executables are built locally
Smoke helper chain including backend restart, actual input grants/dispatch and movement-base log checks
Rendered/fresh-culture runner and its staged-container/input/process-cleanup helpers
Translate helper, reviewed Designer/runtime translations and five actual UE commandlet configurations
Designer asset preparation reads the stable widget contract and native bridge reads the StringTable source JSON
Existing-asset validation delegates to the included animation and cook-label helpers
README selects -Lab Training, so this archive does not require the separate MMORPG archive
Original SM6 patch, runtime verification module and descriptor are included; official map/experience are created in the lab
Runtime verifier consumes the included successful Package report; rerunning package generation replaces it with that reader's own executable paths
Preparation/rerun reads the original preparation script and native Editor bridge
All three official native node texts retain explicit original asset/graph/hash attribution in MANIFEST.externalMaterials

trainingEvidence.audioScope: First-run AudioMixer diagnostic remains in the archived log analysis. The same-executable repeat passed with no Error/Stall; neither this dependency review nor the eleven functional checks certifies audio quality or resolves the first-run cause.

boundaries.externalDependencies: Epic Lyra, the engine Manny template, UE build tools, PostgreSQL/libpq and libsodium are prepared locally using the included manifests/scripts. Their absence from these original-source archives is intentional.
boundaries.generatedLocalState: Credentials, process manifests, cooked containers and native executables are generated by the documented local preparation/build/run sequence; archived historical absolute paths are evidence, not portable prebuilt binaries.
boundaries.snapshotOnly: This conclusion applies only to the exact archive SHA-256 values recorded here. A source/archive refresh requires renewed current-byte validation.
boundaries.selfReference: This report is not included in the archives it reviewed.
